audit_basis: Direct visual recheck of the same front, three-quarter and side overlay plates against the frozen region definitions.
hard_rules: Location is checked before shape: if the overlay is on the wrong anatomical structure, recall is 0 and F1 is 0, even if the colored shape looks heart-like or compact.
Any overlay on an excluded identity feature (eyes, nose, mouth, face) is a precision failure; it cannot be compensated by high coverage elsewhere.
The final view score uses the weakest of the three views for boundary triage; an average cannot hide a side-view or three-quarter-view failure.
If a diagnostic color cannot be distinguished from the source fur, the region is unscorable and treated as failed for the product gate, not awarded an inferred score.
F1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall); when either is 0, F1 is 0.
